tldr: 美伊停火樂觀情緒帶動油價急跌 5%，但美財政赤字與 AI 資本支出結構性壓力仍讓長天期美債殖利率居高難下。
Computex 2026「AI Together」登場，黃仁勳再加碼數十億美元投資台灣，並圈定七大 AI 供應鏈族群作為焦點。
行政院今拍板 TISA 兒少帳戶是否立專法，年支出 1,875 億元的兒童強制儲蓄與家庭主婦國保 23.5% 加碼，將深度影響家庭傳承與財管規劃。
五大金控 Q1 操盤兩極化：國泰金為因應 IFRS 17 資本壓力減碼台股 27%，富邦、凱基反向加碼，凸顯壽險資金配置分歧。
財政部 7/1 起對車位違規改住宅課重稅，並提醒企業 6/1 申報 CFC 虧損；雙重合規時點本週需主動提示客戶。

items.title_zh: 法人喊台股戰 43K 新多頭起跑
items.title_en: Foreign houses target Taiex 43K as new bull leg begins
items.summary_zh: 兩大外資論壇點火 AI 利多，研究機構認為大盤站穩 43,000 點後將進入新一波多頭格局，主軸聚焦半導體與 AI 伺服器供應鏈第三季財測上修。
items.summary_en: Institutional research desks see a fresh bull-market entry point above the 43,000 level, citing two foreign-broker forums catalyzing AI capex narratives and supportive Q3 earnings revisions across the chip and server complex.

items.title_zh: 法人卡位 Computex 13 檔 鴻海、景碩居前
items.title_en: Foreign institutions pre-position 13 Computex names led by Hon Hai, Kinsus
items.summary_zh: Computex 2026 開展前夕，外資已先布局含鴻海、景碩在內的 13 檔焦點股，被動元件、ABF 載板、散熱題材並列法人首選名單。
items.summary_en: Ahead of Computex 2026's opening, foreign brokers' positioning baskets feature Hon Hai (2317) and Kinsus (3189) at the top, with passive components, ABF substrate and cooling plays rounding out a 13-stock shopping list.

items.title_zh: 被動元件集體大噴出 國巨直逼漲停
items.title_en: Passive components break out as Yageo nears limit-up
items.summary_zh: 國巨、日電貿、華新科等 6 檔被動元件成為選股指標，群體噴出反映 AI 伺服器被動元件供給吃緊與報價回穩，國巨距漲停僅一步之遙。
items.summary_en: A six-stock cohort including Yageo, Nichicon Taiwan and Walsin Technology becomes the sector's selection bellwether after a collective rally, signaling renewed pricing power amid tight supply for AI-server passive content.

items.title_zh: 指標型高股息 ETF 調整成分股規則
items.title_en: Top dividend ETF tweaks index methodology for stability
items.summary_zh: 大型高股息 ETF 調整指數編製方法，強化篩選機制並導入穩定設計，影響台股近年最熱的散戶 ETF 配息策略。
items.summary_en: One of Taiwan's flagship high-dividend ETFs is revising its benchmark rules to tighten component screening and add a stability mechanism — a meaningful shift for the retail-driven income-ETF playbook that has dominated TWSE flows.

items.title_zh: 黃仁勳：加碼數十億美元投資台灣 AI 鏈
items.title_en: Jensen Huang pledges tens of billions more for Taiwan AI supply chain
items.summary_zh: 黃仁勳本週密集會見台積電張忠謀、後續還將拜會魏哲家與廣達林百里，確認輝達已在台投入「數千億美元」並將再加碼「數十億美元」，涵蓋台積 CoWoS、廣達／緯創／鴻海 AI 伺服器及散熱、電源、零組件供應鏈。
items.summary_en: On a packed Taipei tour, the Nvidia CEO dined with TSMC's Morris Chang, will meet C.C. Wei and Quanta's Lin Pai-li, and confirmed Nvidia has already spent "hundreds of billions" in Taiwan with "tens of billions" more queued — covering CoWoS at TSMC, AI servers at Quanta/Wistron/Hon Hai, plus cooling, power and components.

items.title_zh: 鴻海全力備戰 Vera Rubin 下半年放量
items.title_en: Hon Hai mobilizes full capacity for Vera Rubin AI servers in H2
items.summary_zh: 輝達次世代 Vera Rubin AI 伺服器平台已備妥，鴻海集中產能於下半年量產出貨，料將拉動台廠 EMS 資本支出，AI 伺服器系統廠能見度延伸至 2027 年。
items.summary_en: Nvidia's next-gen Vera Rubin AI server platform is reportedly production-ready, with Hon Hai marshaling resources for an H2 ramp that should anchor Taiwan EMS capex and lift system-level AI server visibility into 2027.

items.title_zh: Computex 2026「AI Together」鎖定七大族群
items.title_en: Computex 2026 "AI Together" maps Taiwan's seven AI winners
items.summary_zh: 野村投信點名先進製程、先進封裝、高速傳輸、散熱與電源管理、上游原料等七大族群，可望承接全球雲端業者持續上修的 AI 資本支出，獲利能見度延伸至下半年。
items.summary_en: Nomura Investment Trust highlights advanced fabrication, advanced packaging, high-speed interconnect, thermal/power management and upstream materials as the seven sectors set to monetize sustained AI capex by global hyperscalers through 2H 2026.

items.title_zh: 美國量子計畫挹注旺宏、廣達
items.title_en: US quantum initiative routes funding to Macronix and Quanta
items.summary_zh: 美國量子運算國家計畫將資金導向台廠夥伴，旺宏切入儲存環節、廣達拿下系統位置，顯示台灣矽智財與組裝實力已延伸至量子運算戰場。
items.summary_en: Washington's quantum computing programme allocates working capital to selected Taiwanese partners, with Macronix securing storage roles and Quanta winning system positions — early validation that Taiwan's silicon and assembly base extends beyond classical AI.

items.title_zh: 美國拉貨潮帶動運價上揚
items.title_en: Container freight rates climb as US ordering surges
items.summary_zh: 美國通路重啟拉貨碰上運力吃緊，貨櫃航商順勢調漲運價，料將支撐第三季運價與台灣航商獲利，運輸類股迎來補漲行情。
items.summary_en: Tight capacity meeting a fresh wave of US restocking demand has prompted shipping lines to raise rates, a setup that should support Q3 earnings for Taiwanese carriers and re-rate the container shipping group.

items.title_zh: 統一雙喜：康是美、星巴克邁進 600 店
items.title_en: Uni-President's Cosmed and Starbucks both hit 600-store milestone
items.summary_zh: 統一集團旗下康是美與星巴克台灣同步突破 600 店里程碑，反映內需消費韌性，並支撐統一集團持續擴張健康美妝與精品餐飲版圖。
items.summary_en: Uni-President Group celebrated dual retail milestones as Cosmed pharmacy and Starbucks Taiwan each crossed the 600-store mark, signalling continued domestic consumption resilience and giving Uni-President room to push further into health-and-beauty and premium F&B.

items.title_zh: 五大金控 Q1 台股操作兩極化
items.title_en: Big-5 financial holdings split sharply on Q1 TWSE strategy
items.summary_zh: 國泰金為因應 IFRS 17 資本適足壓力，於台股大漲近 10% 之際逆勢減碼 27.2%（－23.3 億），富邦金（＋21.9%／＋9.52 億）、凱基金（＋18.3%／＋3.22 億）反向加碼；五大金控整體部位仍下降 4.4%，反映業界於多頭中獲利了結。
items.summary_en: Cathay Financial slashed Taiwan-stock holdings by 27.2% (–NT$2.33bn) into Q1's near-10% rally, citing IFRS 17 capital-ratio pressure, while Fubon (+21.9% / +NT$952m) and KGI (+18.3% / +NT$322m) leaned in. Combined Big-5 exposure still fell 4.4%, signalling sector-wide profit-taking despite divergent reads on valuations.

items.title_zh: 金管會：3 月底國銀數位存款帳戶達 2,921.6 萬戶
items.title_en: Domestic banks' digital deposit accounts hit 29.2M as of Mar 2026
items.summary_zh: 金管會公布 36 家國銀數位存款帳戶於 3 月底達 2,921.6 萬戶，季增 93.4 萬戶（＋3.3%）；純網銀季增 3.7% 至 328.6 萬戶。第三類（既有關係）帳戶 1,644.1 萬戶居冠，第二類 698.1 萬戶、第一類 579.4 萬戶，確立數位開戶成為新客戶獲取主軸。
items.summary_en: FSC reports 36 banks offering online account opening reached 29.216m accounts at end-March, up 934k (+3.3%) QoQ. Pure-play internet banks grew 3.7% to 3.286m. Type-3 accounts (existing-relationship) lead at 16.44m, followed by Type-2 (6.98m) and Type-1 (5.79m), confirming digital onboarding is now the default customer-acquisition channel.

items.title_zh: 金管會推 IFRS S1/S2 工作坊 助 119 家第二階段公司接軌
items.title_en: FSC rolls out IFRS S1/S2 workshops for 119 phase-2 listed firms
items.summary_zh: 第一階段 125 家公司 2026 年已落地後，金管會為第二階段 119 家公司於 5–6 月舉辦四場 IFRS S2 工作坊、7–8 月加開六場範疇三溫室氣體盤查工作坊，並提供 IFRS S1 重大性議題指引，協助掌握氣候以外的永續揭露重點。
items.summary_en: Following 125 phase-1 companies' compliance in 2026, FSC is supporting 119 phase-2 issuers with four IFRS S2 workshops across north/central/south Taiwan in May–June and six Scope-3 GHG accounting workshops in July–August, plus dedicated IFRS S1 guidance on material non-climate sustainability topics.

items.title_zh: 金管會督導期交所規劃國外成分 ETF 期貨選擇權三階段漲跌幅
items.title_en: FSC blueprint: foreign-component ETF futures/options get 3-tier price-limit mechanism
items.summary_zh: 金管會請期交所設計國外成分證券 ETF 期貨與選擇權的三階段漲跌幅機制，使國內衍生品行情更貼近海外成分標的波動，並降低避險者隔夜跳空風險。
items.summary_en: FSC is directing TAIFEX to design a three-stage daily price-limit mechanism for ETF futures and options tracking foreign components, aiming to align Taiwan derivatives behavior with overseas underlying market volatility and reduce overnight gap risk for hedgers.

items.title_zh: 金管會提醒民眾防範信用卡詐騙盜刷
items.title_en: FSC warns public on credit-card fraud as scam cases climb
items.summary_zh: 銀行局針對信用卡盜刷案件增加再次發布警示，呼籲民眾辨識簡訊／電郵連結真偽、開啟即時消費通知、發現異常立即停卡，反映非實體刷卡詐騙案量上升。
items.summary_en: The Banking Bureau issued a renewed alert urging cardholders to verify SMS/email links, monitor real-time transaction alerts, and freeze cards immediately on suspicious activity, reflecting a rising case load in card-not-present fraud rings targeting Taiwan consumers.

items.title_zh: TISA 兒少帳戶今拍板是否立專法
items.title_en: Cabinet to decide today: TISA youth growth account by standalone law
items.summary_zh: 行政院長卓榮泰今召開會議拍板 0–18 歲每月 5,000 元成長津貼是否以 TISA 專法為架構，6–18 歲每月 2,500 元強制存入外部專業機構管理、設保底機制；全國約 308 萬名兒少受惠，年支出約 1,875 億元，18 歲時可累積至少 36 萬元本金作為教育、創業或購屋／租屋之用。
items.summary_en: Premier Cho meets today to finalize whether the NT$5,000/month 0–18 growth subsidy moves into a dedicated TISA framework, with NT$2,500 of every monthly payment for ages 6–18 mandatorily funneled into externally-managed accounts with guaranteed minimum returns. The programme covers ~3.08m children at ~NT$187.5bn annual cost, delivering at least NT$360k principal by age 18 for education, entrepreneurship or housing.

items.title_zh: 家庭主婦國保提高 23.5% 月領 5,000 元
items.title_en: Homemakers' national pension rises 23.5% to NT$5,000/month
items.summary_zh: 賴清德總統承諾家庭主婦月領 5,000 元，將透過修正《國民年金法》將基本年金由 4,049 元提高至 5,000 元（＋23.5%），適用 65 歲以上未投保職業保險者；行政院編列逾 190 億元，俟立院通過後上路，對高資產客戶配偶之退休基本所得具實質意義。
items.summary_en: President Lai's NT$5,000 monthly homemaker payment will be delivered by amending the National Pension Insurance Act to raise basic pension benefits from NT$4,049 to NT$5,000 (+23.5%) for non-occupationally-insured citizens aged 65+. The Executive Yuan has earmarked NT$19bn+, contingent on Legislative Yuan passage — a meaningful baseline retirement income upgrade for spouses of HNW clients.

items.title_zh: 三大壽險公布青世代投保戰略
items.title_en: Cathay, Fubon, Nan Shan publish playbook for Gen-Z policy purchases
items.summary_zh: 國泰、富邦、南山三大壽險聯手發布青世代投保準則：先求廣再求深、先保大再保小、先保近再保遠，建議青年先以平價定期醫療與重大疾病險打底，待收入成長後再以終身險加保，並隨結婚、購屋、生子等人生階段升級保障。
items.summary_en: Three of Taiwan's largest life insurers jointly recommend the "broad-before-deep / big-before-small / near-before-far" principle for young adults: start with affordable term medical and critical-illness cover, then layer permanent policies as income grows, syncing protection upgrades with marriage, mortgage and parenthood milestones.

items.title_zh: SpaceX 鎖定 6 月中旬上市 概念 ETF 創高
items.title_en: SpaceX targets mid-June IPO; related ETF already at record highs
items.summary_zh: 馬斯克旗下 SpaceX 鎖定 6 月中旬於美掛牌，相關概念 ETF 已搶先創高，吸引散戶與自主財管資金提早卡位太空經濟由私轉公的題材紅利。
items.summary_en: Elon Musk's SpaceX is reportedly targeting a mid-June US listing, and a Taiwan-listed ETF with SpaceX exposure has already hit fresh highs ahead of the debut — pulling forward retail and discretionary-wealth interest in private-to-public space-economy themes.

items.title_zh: 財政部：車位違規改住宅 7 月起加重房屋稅
items.title_en: MOF: parking-lot homes face higher property tax from Jul 1, billed 2027
items.summary_zh: 財政部修法授權地方政府對原登記為停車場或防空避難室、違規改為住宅使用之建物課徵差別較高稅率，2026 年 7 月 1 日生效，於 2027 年房屋稅單反映；以台北市為例可由標準 4.2% 提高至 4.8%；財管顧問應協助客戶清查名下不動產持有結構。
items.summary_en: The Ministry of Finance has empowered local governments to levy differentiated, higher property-tax rates on units originally registered as parking lots or air-raid shelters but illegally converted to residential use. Effective Jul 1 2026 and reflected on 2027 tax bills, Taipei could charge 4.8% vs the standard 4.2% for non-self-occupied multi-units — wealth advisors should screen client property portfolios for exposure.

items.title_zh: CFC 虧損申報 6/1 截止 延期僅限一次 6 個月
items.title_en: CFC loss filings due Jun 1 — extensions limited to one 6-month window
items.summary_zh: 企業 CFC 虧損須於 2026 年 6 月 1 日前申報，以保留未來 10 年抵減 CFC 盈餘之權利；財報未齊備者可申請一次性 6 個月延期；CFC 虧損須經稽徵機關核定後方可扣除，不得僅憑自行列報。
items.summary_en: Companies with controlled foreign corporation losses must file by Jun 1, 2026 to preserve the right to offset future CFC profits over the next 10 years. Firms lacking complete financials may apply for a single six-month extension; losses are only deductible after tax authority approval, not by self-declaration alone.

items.title_zh: 油價跌 5% 美長債殖利率仍居高
items.title_en: Oil –5% but US long-end yields stay sticky on structural drivers
items.summary_zh: 布蘭特原油因美伊停火進展急跌 5.2% 至每桶 98.12 美元，但巴克萊警告美長天期殖利率料維持高檔；主因為「實質利率」受美國財政赤字、AI 資本支出（資料中心與晶片吸走資金）與中性利率上升所撐；摩根大通執行長則點名外國買盤萎縮為結構性壓力，非外交利多可解。
items.summary_en: Brent crashed 5.2% to $98.12 as US–Iran ceasefire talks advanced, yet Barclays warns long-duration Treasury yields will remain elevated. The driver is "real-yield" pressure from US fiscal deficits, AI capex (data centers and chips absorbing capital) and a higher neutral rate; JPMorgan's CEO flags shrinking foreign demand for USTs as a structural overhang diplomatic news cannot resolve.

items.title_zh: 日銀升息恐延後至 6 月 日圓承壓、日股避險升溫
items.title_en: BOJ rate hike likely delayed to June; yen weakens, Nikkei hedging up
items.summary_zh: 市場預期日銀下次升息恐延後至 6 月，日圓承壓並使日股高檔避險需求升溫，對日圓計價結構型商品與未避險之海外債部位皆有影響。
items.summary_en: Markets now read the Bank of Japan as more likely to wait until June for its next rate hike, weighing on the yen and prompting elevated hedging demand around Japanese equity highs — relevant for JPY-linked structured notes and unhedged offshore-bond positions.

items.title_zh: 白宮首席經濟顧問：結束伊朗戰爭可望為 Fed 降息創造空間
items.title_en: White House: ending the Iran war opens space for Fed cuts
items.summary_zh: 白宮經濟顧問指出美伊降溫可降低油價推升通膨之風險，為 Fed 降息創造空間；雖屬政治面利多，Fed 獨立性仍是關鍵變數。
items.summary_en: Top White House economic advisor argues that a US–Iran de-escalation would lower oil-driven inflation risk and create room for the Federal Reserve to cut rates — a fresh political tailwind for the dovish thesis, though Fed independence remains the key gating factor.

items.title_zh: 離岸風電全球逆風 台灣 CPPA 售電價反漲
items.title_en: Offshore wind faces global headwinds yet Taiwan CPPA prices firm up
items.summary_zh: 全球離岸風電案場停建、成本失控頻傳，但台灣企業 CPPA 售電價反向走升，反映半導體與 AI 客戶為鎖定綠電供應而推升結構性需求。
items.summary_en: Despite a wave of global offshore-wind project cancellations and cost overruns, Taiwan's corporate PPA (CPPA) prices have unexpectedly firmed, reflecting structural green-electricity demand from semiconductor and AI customers locking in supply.

items.title_zh: 西班牙馬德里數千人抗議房價飆漲
items.title_en: Madrid mass protest against soaring housing prices
items.summary_zh: 數千民眾聚集西班牙首都馬德里抗議房價飆漲，凸顯居住正義已成全球民主國家的政治風險主軸，並逐步影響各地不動產稅制與分區政策。
items.summary_en: Thousands rallied in central Madrid against runaway housing costs, a vivid reminder that housing affordability has become a top political risk across major democracies — a pattern echoing in Taipei, Toronto and Sydney that increasingly shapes property-related tax and zoning policy.

items.title_zh: 伊朗官員：荷莫茲海峽管理不會回到戰前狀態
items.title_en: Iran: Hormuz Strait management "won't return to pre-war status"
items.summary_zh: 伊朗高層表示荷莫茲海峽管理將不會回到戰前框架，意味德黑蘭擬保留對全球關鍵原油通道之更高槓桿，即使美伊協議推進；對油輪運費、海上保險與原油波動仍構成尾部風險。
items.summary_en: A senior Iranian official said Hormuz Strait management will not revert to its pre-conflict framework, signalling Tehran intends to maintain greater leverage over the critical oil-transit chokepoint even if a US deal progresses — a tail risk for tanker freight, marine insurance and oil-price volatility.

items.title_zh: 小摩：外資 890 億人民幣掃貨 A 股 鎖定機器人、能源安全、AI 三大族群
items.title_en: JPMorgan: foreign capital pours RMB89bn into A-shares, betting on robotics, energy security and AI
items.summary_zh: 摩根大通指出外資以 890 億人民幣掃貨 A 股，鎖定機器人（人形與工業）、能源安全（核能、電網、儲能）與 AI 硬體／應用三大族群；此布局訊號可能外溢至台股科技與 KraneShares 系列 ETF 資金流。
items.summary_en: JPMorgan flags RMB89bn of foreign inflows sweeping mainland A-shares, with three preferred clusters: humanoid/industrial robotics, energy security (nuclear, grid, storage) and AI hardware/applications — a positioning signal that may carry over into Taiwan tech and KraneShares-style ETF flows.

items.title_zh: 美光是繁榮還是泡沫？分析師看 5 年衝 1.45 兆美元
items.title_en: Micron: bubble or boom? Analysts model US$1.45T market cap in 5 years
items.summary_zh: 賣方研究認為 AI 帶動 HBM 與 DRAM 需求，可望推升美光市值於 5 年內衝上 1.45 兆美元；近期股價急漲引發泡沫疑慮，川普公開力挺更加溫，期權盤面顯示川普表態前已有異常買權布局。
items.summary_en: Sell-side desks argue AI-driven HBM and DDR demand could lift Micron to a US$1.45T market cap within five years, even as the stock's vertical run draws bubble comparisons. President Trump's public endorsement added fuel, with options-flow watchers flagging unusual call-side positioning ahead of the comment.

items.title_zh: 沒缺貨卻天價：SATA 固態硬碟 8TB 美售價 13.1 萬台幣
items.title_en: SATA SSD 8TB hits US$4,200 in the US despite no shortage
items.summary_zh: 美國 8TB SATA SSD 售價飆至約 13.1 萬台幣（約 4,200 美元），既無實質缺貨、且相較更快的 NVMe 還更貴，反映通路控量與企業儲存層級錯配。
items.summary_en: A SATA SSD pricing anomaly is making headlines as 8TB SATA drives sell for roughly NT$131,000 (≈US$4,200) in the US despite no genuine supply shortage and despite faster NVMe alternatives being cheaper — pointing to channel rationing and tier-mix distortion across enterprise storage.

items.title_zh: 對伊軍事行動消耗大：日本 400 枚戰斧採購延宕至 2029 年
items.title_en: Japan's 400-unit Tomahawk order pushed to 2029 amid Iran burn-rate
items.summary_zh: 日本 400 枚戰斧巡弋飛彈採購交付延宕至 2029 年，因美方庫存因對伊行動而吃緊；地緣衝突正壓縮全球國防供應鏈，並延長亞洲盟邦軍購時程。
items.summary_en: Japan's planned 400-unit Tomahawk cruise-missile procurement faces delivery delays into 2029 as US inventories run thin from Iran-related strikes — a reminder that geopolitical conflicts are tightening global defense supply chains and lengthening procurement timelines for Asian allies.

items.title_zh: 盧比歐：美伊核協議不可能 72 小時內達成
items.title_en: Rubio: US–Iran deal "won't be done in 72 hours"
items.summary_zh: 美國國務卿盧比歐降溫美伊核協議與停火預期，表示 72 小時內達成「不可能」；繼川普稱協議「尚未完全談妥」推使油價跌至兩週低點後的現實降溫。
items.summary_en: Secretary of State Marco Rubio tempered expectations on the US–Iran nuclear and ceasefire negotiations, telling media a deal in 72 hours is "impossible" — a reality check after Trump's earlier remarks that an agreement is "not yet fully done" pushed oil to a two-week low.
